question: List the top 10 players' names whose heights are above 180 in descending order of average heading accuracy.
final_sql: SELECT player_name FROM ( SELECT P.player_name, SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id WHERE P.height > 180 GROUP BY P.player_fifa_api_id, P.player_name ) ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC LIMIT 10;
